pickText: One friend is a direct message; two or more make a group of up to 10 people.
newGroupText: Choose who else to invite. This conversation stays as it is; the group will be new.
inviteText: New members will see the group's whole history.
groupNameText: All members see it. Leave it empty to show the members' names.
name: Name
noFriends: Only friends can be invited here, and you have none yet. Add someone on the home page.
allHere: All your friends are already here.
addHint: Enter their username: the one your friend signs in to Zazzzor with.
noneOnline: None of your friends are online right now.
noFriendsYet: No friends yet. Add someone by their username.
blockText: The friendship will end, and new requests from this person will stop coming. They won't be told.
removeText: You will stop seeing each other in your friend lists. You can send a request again.
dmGone: You no longer have this conversation.
